checks.evidence: must_read_in_1s: 'A phone held in a hand shows one huge message saying they can get it done cheaper from someone else.' is one clear moment; subjects, hands, props, text, setting, camera all written.
regions list only 'pen-hand' (kind hand); the left hand holding the phone ('holds the phone from below, four fingers around the lower back edge') has no boxed region, and the pen has no prop region.
'The left hand holds the phone from below, fingers around its lower edge; the right hand holds the red pen upright, lifted about 5 cm off the desk... not writing.'

PR-PHONE-SCREEN content: 'exactly one large light-grey incoming bubble near the top of the screen, left-aligned, holding the text... in dark charcoal; no names, no avatars...'. Note: story_critical false on a screen that carries the whole message is a deliberate, noted exception (no prop sheet before the look bible); content is filled, so no empty-prop risk, but the phone must become a sheet prop at step 7.

background_rule: 'No other screens, no posters, no readable words anywhere except the message bubble; the desk is bare apart from a blurred mug'. The one screen is filled.

camera.safe_zones says 'right 13% holds only the pen hand' but setting says 'a blurred mug at the right edge'; 'bottom 10% holds only hand and desk' but the phone box runs to y 96%; size_in_frame says '60% of the frame height' but the phone region box is y 0.34 to 0.96 (62%).
continuity: previous_shot null, carry_over [] (first frame of the hook).
'cap off' never says where the cap is (a model may add a cap, a second pen-like object, or put it in a hand); 'each line about 60 px tall' does not say whether line pitch or letter height.

FL-01: hands boxed away from the bubble (bubble x 0.15 to 0.63, pen-hand x 0.70 to 0.98) with an occlusion rule; FL-05: only screen is filled; FL-09: background_action 'none' is stated (fine for a still concept frame; if this becomes an H3 start frame, add a background action or accept a static room); FL-13 not applicable (no logo strip).
